visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-altitude drone aerial shot, capturing a vast, lush expanse of evergreen forest canopy under bright daylight. In the center of the dense trees, a single, dark rectangular structure is visible from above, creating a sense of secluded discovery. (2) A young woman with long, straight brown hair, wearing a light-colored off-the-shoulder sweatshirt and black pants, stands in the sun-dappled forest. She gestures toward a modern, matte black outdoor sink unit that features an integrated faucet and a rack for dish drying. (3) The camera pans across a wide clearing covered in light grey gravel, showing large wooden deck platforms spaced between tall pine trees. The woman stands in the center of the clearing, gesturing toward the open space while explaining the campsite layout and parking. (4) A transition shows the woman opening a dark door of a red-painted wooden building, revealing a pristine, modern bathroom interior with white tiling and a high-tech washlet toilet. The lighting inside is bright studio-style, contrasting with the natural outdoor light. (5) A dedicated campfire area is depicted, featuring a circular pit constructed from large grey stones with a metal tripod hanging over the center for cooking. The background consists of dense, tall trees with sunlight filtering through the branches onto the gravel ground. (6) A stylish, dark-colored small cabin is featured, with a large beige shade sail extending over an outdoor deck area. The woman walks past the cabin, emphasizing its architecture and its integrated placement within the deep forest environment. (7) A man in a dark green shirt is shown stacking bundles of wooden bark and logs under a sheltered area. Later, a silver Volkswagen van is parked in a designated forest clearing labeled with a wooden sign, showing the car camping area.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 最理想的樹林營區. (2) [Subtitle]: 果然是設計師開的營地. 終於不是一個白帥帥、不鏽鋼的洗手台. 太漂亮了吧. (3) [Subtitle]: 重點是以前大部分是亮不鏽鋼就很突兀. 而且他居然放了燈柱. 這太貼心了. (4) [Subtitle]: 好有日本氛圍感. 這個細節很棒. 就是讓這些人工的設施能夠融入這個環境. (5) [Subtitle]: 右手邊就是大棧板區. 然後這邊的話就是車子不能停旁邊. 車子要移到停車場那邊. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後我們這次廁所是集中式衛浴. 它廁所所有兩間. 這是淋浴間. 有兩間. (7) [Subtitle]: 而且廁所是免治馬桶. (8) [Subtitle]: 哇這裡有一個大營火區欸. 很美式. 美國的國家公園. 他們就是會圍一個這樣的區域. (9) [Subtitle]: 而且終於有你心心念念的吊掛組. (10) [Subtitle]: 老婆 夢想中的小屋又出現了. 對啊 如果可以的話. 自己有一間對不對. 不是 如果可以的話 我一天住露營車 我一天想要住小木屋. (11) [Subtitle]: 你看有這樣的小木屋 在樹林裡面 前面柴爐 這邊有大焚火台. (12) [Subtitle]: 營主有賣木頭. 但它是像樹皮這樣子. 然後它是一捆 300 元. 再自己匯款給老闆. 讚. (13) [Subtitle]: 這就是我們今天的車露區. 它是兩帳的空間. 但真的很美很大.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Background music starts immediately with upbeat acoustic guitar strumming and a light drum beat. A female voice begins narrating with a friendly, high-pitched tone, expressing admiration for the camp's design. Faint birdsong is audible in the ambient mix. (2) A metallic "click" sound is heard as the woman points to the sink. The narration continues expressively, joined by a deeper male voice in conversation. The guitar-driven BGM maintains a steady, happy tempo without interruption. (3) A soft "ding" sound effect marks a visual transition. The female voice describes the gravel layout and parking rules with clear articulation. The sound of light footsteps crunching on gravel can be heard beneath the music bed. (4) Sound of a door latch clicking open as the camera enters the bathroom. The woman’s voice becomes slightly more resonant as she describes the modern toilet facilities. The acoustic guitar BGM maintains its rhythmic drive consistently. (5) A percussive "thud" as wood bundles are moved. The male speaker takes the lead in describing the campfire area, using a professional yet casual conversational tone. Outdoor forest ambience is clearly present under the track. (6) Sound of fabric rustling is audible as the host walks. The male and female speakers engage in a playful, warm dialogue about living in the dream forest cabin. The music continues its happy, lo-fi folk vibe. (7) A rhythmic stacking sound of wooden logs occurs. The female speaker concludes the tour by describing the car camping area. The BGM slowly begins a fade-out as the voices finish, leaving only natural forest ambience.
